title.en: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)
title.hi: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)

definition.en: GATT was a multilateral treaty established in 1947 to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs and quotas.
definition.hi: GATT was a multilateral treaty established in 1947 to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs and quotas.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding GATT is essential for the UPSC GS-3 syllabus as it provides the historical foundation for the modern World Trade Organization (WTO). It helps candidates analyze the evolution of global trade policies and their impact on the Indian economy's integration into the global market.
